claim: A deterministic six-object case reaches a real win screen.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; reveal adjacent facts, arrange the actual seeded order, submit, and assert the scored win screen

claim: The deterministic sample can be completed in under five minutes.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; play the seeded case through its win screen and measure elapsed wall time below 300 seconds

claim: The permanent free case has complete win, loss, and replay outcomes.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /; start the real free case, solve it, replay it, submit the known-wrong starting order, and assert both end screens

claim: Restart restores the active case and all nine comparison tokens.
sandbox: fresh /demo case; spend a comparison, confirm restart, then assert active state, 0/9 comparisons, and the original rule-based deductions

claim: Solo progress stays in this browser and survives reload.
where: first-screen facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; spend a comparison, reload, and assert the same active case and comparison count

claim: Demo changes do not change saved solo data.
where: first screen, demo banner, and demo documentation
sandbox: seed the real storage key, change and reset /demo, then assert the real value is untouched

claim: Starting for real removes demo progress and starts a clean free case.
where: demo banner, privacy page, and demo documentation
sandbox: change the isolated sample, select Start for real, then assert the demo key is gone and a new zero-comparison free case is active

claim: Sound and reduced-motion settings persist in this browser.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; enable both settings, reload, and assert controls and motion mode remain enabled

claim: Solo play needs no account and makes no cross-origin requests.
sandbox: record every request during a demo comparison and assert the product origin is the only origin and no credential fields exist

claim: Play uses no analytics, tracking requests, or advertising cookies.
sandbox: fresh isolated browser; play a demo comparison, visit privacy, and assert every request stays on the product origin, no data request occurs, and neither responses nor the browser contain cookies

claim: Clear saved browser data removes solo progress, demo progress, settings, room access, and the saved license.
sandbox: create every stated data category through the product UI, clear it from the privacy page, assert every product value is absent, and assert unrelated browser values remain

claim: Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls can each change an active case.
sandbox: fresh desktop and touch browser contexts; spend a comparison with mouse plus keyboard, reorder with an arrow key, then spend a comparison by touch

claim: Two independent browsers can solve one shared room case asynchronously.
where: first screen, room panel, and README
sandbox: two isolated browser contexts create and join one room; player one solves; player two reads the server-validated result

claim: Room codes expire after 24 hours.
where: first-screen facts, privacy page, terms, and room panel
sandbox: create a room through the live local API and assert its server expiry is 24 hours from creation

claim: A room accepts two players and rejects a third.
sandbox: three independent request contexts; create and join a room, then assert the third join receives HTTP 409 and the full-room message

claim: The room service stores only hashed room access tokens in SQLite.
sandbox: create a room through the production handler against fresh SQLite, then assert the stored value differs from the returned access token and equals its 64-character SHA-256 hash

claim: A $6 one-time license unlocks 19 paid cases, for 20 total.
where: paid section, license page, terms, and README
sandbox: recorded valid Sociobot verification fixture; assert the token leaves the URL and all 19 paid case choices appear beside the exact price

claim: Each of the 20 curated cases has its own exhibit set and placement rule that changes deductions.
where: game board, paid section, and README
sandbox: generate all 20 curated cases; assert distinct rule text and exhibit sets, validate each hidden order against its rule, and prove the rule narrows the possible orders

claim: A refunded or revoked license stops unlocking paid cases after verification.
sandbox: recorded valid then revoked Sociobot verification fixtures; assert paid choices appear after valid verification and disappear after revocation

claim: Active play renders at 50 frames per second or better in the test phone-class browser profile.
sandbox: fresh active demo; measure requestAnimationFrame callbacks and fixed-step updates for more than two seconds
